notes.title: Update (4/19/2018)
notes.content:
As many of you know there has not been an update for Dark in a long time. 

We realized this is a much bigger project than we originally intended. For players (and for us) to be happy with the game we need a lot more systems for multiplayer and beyond. I would like to remind you that PotatoFaceGames is an Indie Developer with limited man power and resources. (aka we're small) I PotatoFaceJames am a Game Developer freelancer and have been working on more projects to bring you multiplayer VR games (and the studio some money so we can spend the time working on Dark). However, sadly that means that for now Dark has been put on the back burner for PotatoFaceGames.

The game is still a good early preview of what we're making. (and is still very fun and entertaining to play) Any sale that is made still contributes towards the development of this game.  

I invite all of you to join our discord (https://discord.gg/pFYupdA), I'm basically there all the time working on games and/or doing QA with other developers. 

PotatoFaceJames

notes.title: 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to 1.1! This is a list of changes as follows. 

[h1]1.1 Patch Notes:[/h1] 

General Overview
[list]
	[*]Updated first half of Frontier
	[*]New Model for Skeletons
	[*]New Enemies!
	[*]New Modes!
	[*]More Content!
[/list]	
New Mode: Endlesss  with four new maps specifically for smashing baddies in the face. Designed for quick in and out gameplay: perfect for arcades. 
[list]
	[*]Easy
	[*]Hard
	[*]Death
	[*]Beholder Fight
[/list]
New Enemies
[list]
	[*]Slime
		[list]
			[*]Vomits on you! 
			[*]Grows in size when it kills slimes
		[/list]
	[*]Skeleton Arm
		[list]
			[*]Has a chance to spawn after you kill skeletons
			[*]Will leap at you and try to grab you, dealing DPS when it grabs hold
		[/list]
	[*]Skeleton
		[list]
			[*]Now has weakpoint, hit it for extra damage and explosions!
		[/list] 
[/list]	

Updated Frontier
[list]
	[*]Beginning Cave
	[*]Forest
	[*]Bridge
	[*]Town Entrance
	[*]Castle Courtyard
[/list]
Bug Fixes: 
[list]
	[*]Skeletons no longer cause fatal crash! 
	[*]Damage is a little more balanced
	[*]gameplay balances
[/list]

notes.title: Dark: Frontier | Patch Notes: 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, PotatoFaceJames here! Spent some time this week doing more utility and bug fixes. Got a LOT of great feedback from everyone, as a lot of what is on this list was feedback from users. 

[h1]v1.0.0.1 Patch notes:[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
	[*]Added water physics and post processing for the water in Frontier
	[*]Added Sprint Function: Click in movement to sprint
		[list]
    			[*]Rogue doesn't have sprint, still has dash ability
    			[*]2 seconds of stamina/2 seconds recharge, still working on audio cues
		[/list]
	[*]Updated Server Browser
		[list]
    			[*]New Quickmatch button
    			[*]Easier interaction + visual feedback
		[/list]
	[*]Updated Weapon physics
		[list]
			[*]Velocity based
			[*]better hit responses
			[*]can hit multiple enemies with one swing
		[/list]
[/list]
[b]Paladin[/b]
[list]
	[*]smite now works even if not grabbing sword (this lets the player wield the sword in either hand)
	[*]shield has more reliable hitbox

[/list]
[b]Wizard[/b]
[list]
	[*]haptic feedback on spells
	[*]fixed particle effect overglow on fire/ice beam
[/list]

Thank you to our Patreons and Players! Your feedback, support, and encouragement is THE most valuable thing to us! 

PotatoFaceJames

notes.title: Heavily Community Based
notes.content:
[h1]We want you to be a part of our community[/h1] 

Yes, you! We value your feedback and want to hear it. If you have any questions you can post in the discussions and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. 

If you're looking for more direct interaction you should hop on our [url=https://discord.gg/SBFFtX4]Discord Channel[/url]. There you can talk directly to us, the developers, about our game. Or, if you're wanting someone to talk to and hang out that's cool too! 

Hope to hear from you! 

[b] the PotatoFaceGames team[/b]

notes.title: Early Access!!!
notes.content:
[h1]This is it! We're bringing our flagship title to Steam.[/h1]

It feels like we've been working on this for so long, and even though everyone here is super tired; We're also super excited! 

Last night we had a great time debuting our game here at [url=https://vraustin.org/]VR Austin[/url]. Huge shout out to them for putting everything together at that amazing venue that is [url=https://www.impacthubaustin.com/]Vuka North Lamar and ImpactHub[/url]. Also a big thank you to [url=http://farbridge.com/]FarBridge[/url] for sponsoring it and making sure our computers had a wired connection. 

Thank you so much to everyone who's been helping us get to this point, we couldn't have done it without you! 

[b]PotatoFaceGames[/b]
